Il fegato è la sede più frequente di met:
The liver is the most frequent site of metastases from colorectal carcinoma (about a quarter of patients at diagnosis). In the portal phase the metastases are hypodense, often with a denser peripheral rim (“target” appearance); cysts, by contrast, are fluid-density, homogeneous, with sharp margins; hemangiomas show peripheral nodular enhancement that fills in over time.
The report needs number, location by segment, largest diameter, relationship to the hepatic veins, portal vein and vena cava: these determine whether the metastases are resectable. MRI with a hepatospecific contrast agent and diffusion also finds the smallest lesions.
In un paziente con tumore del colon, les: In a patient with colon cancer, multiple hypodense liver lesions in the portal phase are metastases until proven otherwise.
Resezione epatica: metastasi multiple bi: Liver resection: multiple synchronous bilobar metastases from colorectal carcinoma, maximum diameter 5.5 cm; no chemotherapy before surgery (Colorectal-Liver-Metastases clinical data).
